SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q10. Which of the following is NOT a feature of the organized sector?  
(A) Fixed working hours  
(B) Paid holidays  
(C) Employment is not secure  
(D) Provisions for provident fund

Answer / Solution:
Which of the following is NOT a feature of the organized sector? 
(C) Employment is not secure 
Reasoning: In the organized sector, employment is secure.
